text: It would be quite contrary to all that we know of nature if men were an exception to so general a rule: if a creature so defenceless as man was at his beginnings should have found his protection and his way to progress, not in mutual support, like other animals, but in a reckless competition for personal advantages, with no regard to the interests of the species.
author: Peter Kropotkin
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter III, Mutual Aid Among Savages
